entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: Top tier of New Capenna above the Mezzio, home of the Brokers and the city's bosses and titans of industry.

entities.description: Family whose primary home was Park Heights.

entities.description: Family with a stronghold in the Cloud Spire.

entities.name: Cloud Spire
entities.description: Skyscraper that served as Obscura stronghold.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor killed when Park Heights collapsed on her.
